name: analyze-account-multithreading-quality
description: Multi-threading map should assign unique orders (1-4) and role-specific messaging focuses — not identical boilerplate across the 4 roles.

businessContext.overview: Deal-flow audit + forecast confidence for RevOps teams.

expectations.rubric: A great multi-threading map assigns each of the 4 roles (entry, champion, economic buyer, technical gatekeeper) a distinct real-world role title, unique order 1-4, differentiated messagingFocus per role, and 2-3 coordination rules that name real risks (e.g. 'never CC IT and CFO in the same thread — competing priorities'). Identical or boilerplate content across roles scores low.
